messages:
Priya Nair: Quick sync: finalizing private deploy GA gates. Sharing a short checklist and tradeoffs. Please call out missing crash gates.
Ethan Lowe: KMS question: GA or beta? Enterprise customers insist on key ownership.
Diego Ramos: Recommend GA for enterprise tier; self-serve can default to Redwood-managed keys with opt-in. Need rotation test.
Jules Kim: Network docs must be prescriptive: ports, proxy vars, expected CIDR/peering behavior, and NAT edge cases.
Priya Nair: Proposed GA checklist concise:
- Installer: offline bundle OR documented air-gap beta path
- Customer KMS support (cloud + KMIP HSM) or explicit fallback
- Prometheus metrics endpoint + scrape guidance
- Deterministic upgrade with rollback script + schema compatibility test
- Peering handshake API + IP preservation guidance
- Operator UX: pin models, canary percentages, fallback to hosted
- Automated smoke e2e validating model load and routing policy
Any other must-haves?
Diego Ramos: Add key-rotation test: rotate key, assert zero inference failures for 10m. Infra owns harness.
Ethan Lowe: Also add logs/alerts retention defaults and security checklist for KMS permissions.
Jules Kim: Upgrade SLA: target <5% request loss during upgrade window and provide network quiesce steps.
Priya Nair: Launch gates proposed:
1) Internal e2e pass
2) Two pilots (cloud-VPC peer + air-gapped if possible) with success criteria
3) Docs and runbooks in repo
4) Security signoff for KMS & networking
Diego Ramos: Infra will run rotation harness. Plan: simulate rotation, monitor for 10m no-fail, revert.
pkg-bot: Pilot checklist generated: https://ci.redwood.internal/installer/checklists/2390001
Priya Nair: Action items:
- Priya: update checklist with metrics & operator UX (Tue)
- Diego: deliver harness + rotation test plan (Mon)
- Jules: cloud pilot recruitment + upgrade metrics (Wed)
- Ethan: air-gap pilot outreach + templated install checklist (Fri)
Tradeoff: can ship GA earlier without air-gap (label as 'air-gapped beta') ~3 week speedup, but sales risk. I'll escalate to PM leads today.
